title: Nvidia’s Board CEO Hunt, Stocks Finish Week Higher, Retail in Focus
summary: Bloomberg Television brings you the latest news and analysis leading up to the final minutes and seconds before and after the closing bell on Wall Street. Today's guests are Franklin Templeton Institute’s Head Market Strategist Chris Galipeau, Pershing Square’s Founder and CEO Bill Ackman, London Business School Leadership Institute’s Founding Director Randall Peterson, Committee For A Responsible Federal Budget’s President Maya MacGuineas, Real Macro’s CEO and Founder Jeff Currie, Northwestern
